firstPlayerRule: The player who can count down from ten fastest takes the first turn of round one.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player chooses and rolls the dice. All players then take part in the discard-or-take-a-token step.
